label.zh: 美国联邦能源监管委员会冬季评估

title.en: A 245 GW winter-peak warning for North America. This winter’s grid has a different outlook.
title.zh: 十年冬峰或增245吉瓦，北美今冬常态下却够用

summary.en: FERC cites a NERC projection of roughly 245 GW in additional North American winter peak demand over the next decade, driven mostly by large loads, chiefly data centers. But the assessment expects enough resources this winter under normal conditions.
summary.zh: 美国联邦能源监管委员会援引 NERC 预测：未来十年北美冬季峰值负荷或增加约 245 吉瓦，新增数据中心是主要推力。评估同时预计，正常天气下今冬资源足以应对需求。

takeaway.en: The projection concerns power at peak times, not annual energy consumed or a confirmed shortage.
takeaway.zh: 预测衡量的是高峰时段的功率，不是全年用电量，也不代表已经出现缺电。

title.en: Anthropic found gaps in its own defenses. What did its tests miss?
title.zh: Anthropic 自测抓到漏洞，没抓到的呢？

summary.en: Anthropic says its automated stress tests uncovered weaknesses its safeguards did not catch. The disclosure describes what the developer found, not what an independent review would find.
summary.zh: Anthropic 披露，自动化压力测试发现了自家防护没有挡住的问题。这是开发方的测试结果，不能据此判断未被测到的风险有多大。

takeaway.en: A developer describing what its tests caught is not an independent assessment of what they missed.
takeaway.zh: 开发者披露了测试发现的问题；这不等于有人独立评估过漏检的问题。

label.zh: 美国消费者金融保护局公告

title.en: Credit complaints surged. How much of the rise was AI?
title.zh: 美国征信投诉暴增，多少是AI替人提交的？

summary.en: The CFPB lists AI tools acting on behalf of consumers alongside credit-repair firms and other intermediaries as possible contributors to complaint growth. The total alone does not separate these factors.
summary.zh: 美国消费者金融保护局把代消费者提交投诉的 AI 工具，与信用修复机构等列为投诉增长的多个因素。总投诉量不能拆出各因素分别占多少。

takeaway.en: Complaint volume alone tells us neither how many submissions involved AI nor which complaints have merit.
takeaway.zh: 仅凭投诉总量，既不能判断多少投诉涉及 AI，也不能判断哪些投诉有理有据。

label.zh: 《2026 国际人工智能安全报告》

title.en: The International AI Safety Report asks what a passing pre-launch score proves in the real world.
title.zh: AI上线前过了关，安全报告为何不把它当通行证？

summary.en: The 2026 report distinguishes misuse, malfunctions and systemic risks. It warns that pre-deployment evaluations cannot reliably predict real-world usefulness or risk: the setting is part of the result.
summary.zh: 《2026 国际人工智能安全报告》区分滥用、系统失灵和系统性风险，并指出上线前评测不能可靠预测真实场景中的效用或风险。换了环境，原来的分数未必还管用。

takeaway.en: Ask where the system will be used before treating a test score as evidence that it belongs there.
takeaway.zh: 先问系统将在哪里使用，再判断测试分数能否支持在那里部署。

label.en: Final prospectus filed with the SEC
label.zh: 提交美国证交会的最终招股说明书

title.en: A $1.5 billion copyright bill in Anthropic’s IPO paperwork
title.zh: 翻开Anthropic招股书：一笔15亿美元的版权和解账

summary.en: The prospectus says Anthropic booked the $1.5 billion Bartz settlement in 2025 and that a district court approved it in July 2026. The filing discloses an earlier settlement, not a new fine.
summary.zh: 招股书显示，Anthropic 已于 2025 年计提 15 亿美元 Bartz 版权案和解费用，地区法院于 2026 年 7 月批准和解。文件披露的是旧案账目，并非新罚款。

takeaway.en: This is one example of the cost of a rights dispute. The filing describes an earlier settlement, not a new fine.
takeaway.zh: 这是版权争议成本的一个实例。文件披露的是此前的和解，并非新增罚款。

title.en: If AI causes harm, can the person held responsible even intervene?
title.zh: AI若出了事，担责的人连系统都管不了？

summary.en: Lena Schneider and colleagues introduce ALIGN to identify gaps between who is expected to answer for high-risk AI use and who has meaningful control. Evaluating a governance method is not evidence that deployed systems became safer.
summary.zh: Lena Schneider 团队提出 ALIGN，检视高风险 AI 中谁承担问责、谁实际有控制权，以及两者何时错位。研究评估的是治理方法，不是部署后事故是否变少。

takeaway.en: Useful for assigning responsibility, but it still needs real-world validation before anyone treats it as a safety fix.
takeaway.zh: 它对厘清责任有用，但在被当作安全修复方案之前，仍需要真实场景验证。

title.en: OpenAI wants more proof before launch. Who checks what slips through?
title.zh: OpenAI 给发布加了一道门，谁来查漏网风险？

summary.en: OpenAI says it now asks for stronger alignment evidence during training and written safety arguments before deployment. A higher bar on paper is not yet an independent measure of the risks it catches in practice.
summary.zh: OpenAI 称训练阶段要提供更强的对齐证据，部署前还要写出有证据支撑的安全论证。门槛是否真的拦下更多风险，这份流程说明没有给出独立验证。

takeaway.en: The signal is a tighter governance process; the open question is whether the process consistently catches dangerous gaps before release.
takeaway.zh: 可见信号是治理流程更严格；仍待验证的是，这套流程能否在发布前稳定识别出危险缺口。

label.en: OpenAI blog: Managing frontier AI risk
label.zh: OpenAI 博文：管理前沿 AI 风险

title.en: Stop every bad answer, let every good one through: when AI guardrails cannot do both
title.zh: 坏答案全拦，好答案全放：AI护栏何时两难？

summary.en: Ahmed Amer and colleagues examine when an output policy can be enforced without misses. Their result bounds what can be promised in general; it does not rule out useful safeguards for specific policies.
summary.zh: Ahmed Amer 等人分析哪些模型输出规则可以无遗漏地执行。论文限制的是对所有场景的安全承诺，不是否认具体场景里的护栏有用。

takeaway.en: It concludes that “no perfect guardrail” is justified by computability limits on output policies for large language models, rather than by saying guardrails are useless.
takeaway.zh: 它据此得出结论：对大语言模型的输出策略而言，护栏受可计算性限制影响，因此“不存在完美护栏”是由计算能力边界所支持，而非宣称护栏毫无用处。

label.en: arXiv cs.AI — No Perfect Guard & No Perfect Guard: On the Decidability of Output Policies for Large Language Models
label.zh: arXiv cs.AI——No Perfect Guard & No Perfect Guard：关于大语言模型输出策略可判定性

title.en: What’s a coding-agent score worth if the grader isn’t independent?
title.zh: 裁判不独立，编码智能体的高分还值多少？

summary.en: Researchers behind SplitBench argue that executing a coding agent’s submission and deciding its score should be separate jobs. Isolating the grader protects evaluation integrity, but it cannot fix every weakness in the original tests.
summary.zh: SplitBench 研究者把运行编码智能体的提交和判定结果拆开，避免被测代码左右评分。隔离保护的是评分环节，不能替代对原有测试的质量检查。

takeaway.en: It motivates privilege separation / audit approaches for coding-agent benchmarks to reduce opportunities for agents to game the evaluation environment.
takeaway.zh: 它用上述问题来支撑对代码型智能体基准进行权限隔离/审计等方法的必要性，以减少智能体操纵评测环境的机会。

label.en: arXiv cs.AI — Who Grades the Agent? Privilege Separation for Coding-Agent Benchmarks
label.zh: arXiv cs.AI——Who Grades the Agent？用于代码型智能体基准的权限隔离

title.en: DeepMind cut a fusion circuit’s cost to about 1/12. When can hardware run it?
title.zh: DeepMind聚变电路成本降到约1/12，离上机还有多远？

summary.en: DeepMind reported an 11.8-fold reduction in a combined qubit-and-operation cost metric for one fusion-related calculation. Lean checked the mathematics; today’s hardware did not run the full circuit.
summary.zh: DeepMind 把一项聚变相关计算的量子比特与操作量综合成本降到约原来的 1/11.8。Lean 验证了数学结果，现有硬件并未运行完整电路。

takeaway.en: DeepMind says the proposed simulations would still exceed the likely resources of first-generation error-corrected quantum computers. The research improved a computational method, not a real fusion reactor.
takeaway.zh: DeepMind 指出，这类模拟仍可能超过第一代纠错量子计算机的资源上限。改进的是计算方法，不是现实里的聚变装置。

claim.en: New Intelligence linked Gemini’s quantum-algorithm work to a dramatic leap in fusion progress.
claim.zh: 新智元把 Gemini 的量子算法改进写成聚变进度条拉满。

title.en: On RDQA, generic agents topped out at 24%. A tailored system hit 41.1%.
title.zh: RDQA通用智能体最高24%，专用方案冲到41.1%

summary.en: On 1,350 source-dependent questions, RDQA’s best of 12 general-purpose configurations scored 24.0% after checking source use; a purpose-built baseline reached 41.1%. Missing a verified trace is not proof the model answered from memory.
summary.zh: 在 1,350 道依赖原始资料的题上，把能否核验指定来源算进去后，12 个通用配置最高为 24.0%，专项基线为 41.1%。没留下合格溯源，不代表答案一定是背出来的。

takeaway.en: A correct answer without a verified trace is ungrounded by this benchmark’s definition. That does not establish that the model memorized the answer. Audit the source and the retrieval trace, not just the final answer.
takeaway.zh: 按论文的定义，答对但轨迹没证明查到指定材料，只能判定证据不达标，不能断定模型靠背。评估搜索时，答案和取证过程都要看。

claim.en: New Intelligence framed the result as agents pretending to search, with just 24% accuracy.
claim.zh: 新智元用「假装搜索、仅 24% 准确率」概括这项 Agent 测试。

title.en: Anthropic puts forward a VP≠VNP proof. The million-dollar P vs NP problem is still open.
title.zh: Anthropic公布VP≠VNP证明，百万美元的P vs NP还没解

summary.en: Anthropic released an AI-authored paper and Lean formalization claiming VP and VNP differ over every field. The release says no human mathematician had checked the proof at publication; the claim concerns arithmetic circuits, not the Clay problem.
summary.zh: Anthropic 发布由 AI 撰写的论文和 Lean 形式化版本，主张在任意域上 VP 与 VNP 不相等。发布说明称当时尚无人类数学家核查证明；它研究的是算术电路，不是克雷千禧难题。

takeaway.en: The claim concerns arithmetic circuits. Clay’s P vs NP problem concerns decision problems in Boolean computation and remains listed as unsolved.
takeaway.zh: 这项主张讨论算术电路。克雷研究所的 P vs NP 是关于布尔计算中判定问题的千禧难题，仍列为未解决。

claim.en: New Intelligence described a Lean-checked result as the algebraic version of P ≠ NP.
claim.zh: 新智元把这项 Lean 核验成果称为「代数版 P≠NP」。

title.en: America’s Genesis Mission selected 297 projects. Where’s the speedup?
title.zh: 美国创世纪计划立项297个，科研究竟快了多少？

summary.en: The US Department of Energy reports 297 selected projects across 369 institutions. Doubling research productivity and impact is a decade-long goal, not a year-one result measured by this count.
summary.zh: 美国能源部报告称，入选的 297 个项目涉及 369 家机构。十年内让科研生产力和影响力翻倍是计划目标，这份首年项目统计并没有测出提升幅度。

takeaway.en: Project selection measures activity, not outcomes. Look for comparable time-to-result, replication rates, and independently checked discoveries when assessing the program.
takeaway.zh: 立项数量衡量的是投入和活动。要评估产出，应等可比较的研究耗时、复现率和独立核验的发现。

claim.en: New Intelligence’s anniversary coverage emphasized the global momentum of the US Genesis Mission.
claim.zh: 新智元在美国「创世纪」一周年报道里强调计划带来的全球热度。

title.en: Vals AI made shortest paths faster on paper. Where are the large-graph timings?
title.zh: Vals AI压低最短路复杂度，大图实测呢？

summary.en: In September, Vals AI reported a Lean-verified improvement for a particular range of graph densities, with no timing results on large graphs. Duan and colleagues had already beaten Dijkstra’s sparse directed-graph bound in 2025.
summary.zh: Vals AI 9 月报告的成果是在特定图密度范围内，经 Lean 核验的渐近界改进，没有大型图的实测耗时。Duan 等人在 2025 年已打破 Dijkstra 在稀疏有向图上的复杂度界。

takeaway.en: Credit the new bound. Before replacing a production algorithm, compare implementations on the graphs you run, including wall-clock time and memory.
takeaway.zh: 新上界是实打实的进展。真要替换生产算法，还得在自己的图上测运行时间和内存。

claim.en: New Intelligence framed the Claude-assisted result as a first overturning of Dijkstra’s shortest-path algorithm.
claim.zh: 新智元把 Claude 参与的最短路成果写成「首次颠覆 Dijkstra」。

title.en: Anthropic can change what Claude says. Did it prove Claude feels anything?
title.zh: Anthropic动了Claude内部信号，能证明它有感受吗？

summary.en: In July, Anthropic reported that altering certain internal signals changed Claude’s responses in controlled tests. The research describes a measurable function rather than evidence of subjective experience.
summary.zh: Anthropic 7 月报告称，在受控实验中干预一部分内部表征会改变 Claude 的回答。研究测到的是可观测的功能，不能说明模型是否有主观体验。

takeaway.en: This is evidence about how a model processes information. It does not answer whether there is anything it feels like to be that model.
takeaway.zh: 结果推进了对模型如何处理信息的理解，但并未回答模型有没有主观感受。

label.zh: Anthropic 原始研究及其局限

claim.en: New Intelligence’s headline asks whether Claude has consciousness after researchers found and could alter an internal representation.
claim.zh: 新智元以「Claude 有意识了？」引出一项可读取和干预内部表征的研究。

title.en: Astra helped prove a Goldbach variant whose summands can be composite. Even 8 qualifies.
title.zh: Astra参与证明哥德巴赫变体，连合数8都能当加数

summary.en: The Lean theorem from September expresses even numbers above two as sums of two integers with odd prime-factor counts, including multiplicity. Such integers need not be prime: eight is 2 × 2 × 2.
summary.zh: 9 月公开的 Lean 定理把大于 2 的偶数表示为两个质因子个数为奇数的整数之和，重复因子也计数。这些整数未必是素数，例如 8 = 2 × 2 × 2。

takeaway.en: It is a theorem about a larger class of summands. The formal statement does not prove that the two summands can always be chosen to be prime.
takeaway.zh: 这是对一类更宽的加数成立的定理。它没有证明两个加数总能同时取素数。

claim.en: New Intelligence described a GPT-6 Astra result as a significant Goldbach breakthrough.
claim.zh: 新智元把 GPT-6 Astra 参与的成果描述为哥德巴赫猜想的重大突破。
